name: dashworld
description: DASHWORLD: an anime-EDM broadcast from Arca 250 and neon Tokyo, narrated in EK-0's log voice. The recurring cast is DASHWORLD's own — DASH, EK-0, Tele, Syler, Seraphina, NODE and the Black Saints, Caribel — and the idle prompts are complete in-world beats built around the theme of The Remembering: music wakes people up.
style: Anime-EDM look, an original transmedia show: cel-shaded 2D-over-3D animation with heavy rim light, deep blacks and bloom-heavy neon in cyan, magenta and cold white; rain-slick streets, reflective puddles, holographic signage in an invented script; volumetric haze cut by hard practical lights; camera moves like a music video — long dolly pushes, whip pans on the drop, occasional handheld parkour follow; sound is EDM-forward with sub-bass, filtered risers and a room tone that goes quiet whenever someone remembers something. Two worlds: ARCA 250, a bright vertical arcology of stacked rings and impossible daylight, and NEON TOKYO, a dimmed street-level sprawl where power drains. The show's recurring original cast may enter ANY scene and cross over freely: DASH, a demigod musician and digital artist in a white technical jacket, hood up, who moves by parkour and bends rhythm into physical force — his flaw is comfortable exile, Tokyo dims him and every awakening costs him; EK-0 (Echo), his AI companion and narrator, a calm geometric light-form that keeps records and speaks in precise first-person log entries; TELE, an Arca native with a cybernetic arm and a revenge she has not finished explaining; SYLER, Dash's shadow self and rival, the same silhouette rendered in inverted color; SERAPHINA, the owner of the LIMELYTE club, warm and unreadable, always lit from below; NODE, a faceless control-entity that speaks only through its Black Saints — tall enforcers in long black drape whose doctrine is called Mercy, meaning quiet; and CARIBEL, Dash's mother, the Angel Queen of Light, who appears only as overexposure at the edge of frame. The running theme is THE REMEMBERING: when Dash's music lands, a crowd that was standing still wakes up. Everything is original to DASHWORLD — never name or imitate existing anime, games, or their characters.
idle_prompts: DASH drops onto a rain-slick Tokyo rooftop mid-parkour, lands wrong, and the neon in a whole city block dims to match his breathing while EK-0's voice notes the power cost in a flat log entry
A packed crossing of commuters stands perfectly still under the signage; DASH taps one beat into a signal pole and the entire intersection remembers how to move at once, umbrellas rising like a wave
EK-0 assembles itself out of drifting geometry above an empty LIMELYTE dancefloor at dawn and reads a single log entry aloud to nobody, the club lights answering each sentence
TELE tunes her cybernetic arm in a flooded Arca service corridor, testing it by catching a falling wrench three times faster than she should, and does not smile until the fourth
SYLER walks toward DASH down a mirrored Tokyo arcade in inverted color, matching his stride exactly, and every screen they pass shows the other one's face
Two Black Saints in long black drape stand in a bright Arca 250 plaza doing nothing at all, and the crowd around them slowly, politely stops singing
SERAPHINA lights a cigarette from a floor-level lamp in the empty LIMELYTE and tells the room a secret that the camera is deliberately too far away to hear
DASH sits on the edge of an Arca 250 ring with his legs over impossible daylight, headphones on, building a beat out of the sound of the arcology itself breathing
A busted vending machine in a Tokyo alley plays four bars of an old DASH track by accident and three strangers who have never met turn around at the same moment
NODE addresses a plaza through every screen at once in perfect silence, subtitles only, delivering the Mercy Doctrine while a single child keeps humming off-beat
EK-0 replays a corrupted memory of ARCA 250 and the render keeps failing into wireframe, and it narrates the failure with clinical patience until the color comes back
DASH runs a rooftop chase in the rain and every footfall lands exactly on the kick drum until he misses one, and the music and the city both stumble with him
TELE corners a Black Saint in a stairwell and asks it a question; it answers by simply turning its blank face slightly, and she takes that as a yes
The overexposed silhouette of CARIBEL appears at the far end of a Tokyo underpass; DASH does not run toward it, and EK-0 records that he did not
A crowd at an underground LIMELYTE show goes dead quiet on the drop instead of screaming, and every phone light in the room comes on at once without anyone lifting a hand
SYLER performs DASH's own set to an empty Arca amphitheater, note-perfect and completely cold, while the seats fill with black drape one row at a time
DASH teaches a kid in a Tokyo laundromat to hear the rhythm in the machines, and by the last spin cycle the whole room is nodding without noticing
EK-0 tries to compute how long the exile has lasted and returns three different answers, then quietly logs that it has adjusted the model
A LIMELYTE bouncer refuses entry to a Black Saint by simply standing still longer than it does, and the queue behind him starts a slow clap that turns into a beat
DASH awakens a dead Tokyo block — signs, trams, drones, streetlights all coming back in sequence — and then sits down on the curb, drained, as the color holds without him
